topic_name: Where Is the Centre?
title: The mean of two numbers sits halfway
description: Shows that the mean of 3 and 7 is 5, exactly halfway between them.

topic_name: The Balancing Act: How the Mean Changes
title: The mean is the balance point
description: Shows that the mean 12 of 10, 10, 11 and 17 balances the distances on its two sides.

topic_name: The Balancing Act: How the Mean Changes
title: The centre of 2, 6, 10 and 12 is 7.5
description: Shows that the mean balances the distances even when it falls between the dots.

topic_name: The Balancing Act: How the Mean Changes
title: A new value above the mean pulls it up
description: Before and after: adding 17 to the data 5, 5, 10, 24 moves the mean from 11 up to 12.2.

topic_name: The Balancing Act: How the Mean Changes
title: Two new values, same mean
description: Shows that adding 7 and 15, one 4 below and one 4 above the mean 11, leaves the mean at 11.

topic_name: The Balancing Act: How the Mean Changes
title: Add 10 to every value, the mean moves 10
description: Shows that when every value goes up by 10 the mean also goes up by exactly 10.

topic_name: The Balancing Act: How the Mean Changes
title: Take 2 from every value, the mean drops by 2
description: Shows the algebra: each of n values loses 2, the sum loses 2n, and dividing by n gives a − 2.

topic_name: The Balancing Act: How the Mean Changes
title: Drag a dot, the mean follows
description: Shows the core move of the dot plot explorer: dragging one dot to the right pulls the mean to the right.

topic_name: Tinkering with the Median and Finding the Unknown
title: A value above the median moves it up
description: Shows that including 11, which is above the median 8, makes the two middle values 8 and 11 and the median 9.5.

topic_name: Tinkering with the Median and Finding the Unknown
title: Finding the missing weight
description: Shows the total 392 from mean times count, split into the 9 known weights 349 and the missing weight 43.

topic_name: Tinkering with the Median and Finding the Unknown
title: Fixing a total to fix the mean
description: Shows the three steps that correct the coconut harvest mean: total, corrected total, corrected mean.

topic_name: Tinkering with the Median and Finding the Unknown
title: Total minus known gives the missing value
description: Shows the core move of the practice: mean times count gives the total, and the total minus the known values gives the missing value.

topic_name: Mean and Median with Frequencies
title: Every family counted: the mean is 5.22
description: Shows the family size data as stacks of dots, with the balance point near 5.22, not 6.5.

topic_name: Mean and Median with Frequencies
title: Finding the median by running totals
description: Shows the 36 family sizes as one row of 36 cells in blocks, with the 18th and 19th cells landing in the block of size 5.

topic_name: Mean and Median with Frequencies
title: Each value counts as often as it occurs
description: Shows the core of the frequency table practice: each value is multiplied by its frequency, the products are added, and the total is shared over all the values.

topic_name: Spreadsheets: Totals and Averages Fast
title: A cell is named by column and row
description: Shows that the cell where column E meets row 5 is called E5 and holds 42.

topic_name: Spreadsheets: Totals and Averages Fast
title: One formula adds a whole row
description: Shows the formula =SUM(B3:G3) adding Nagesh's six marks into one result cell.

topic_name: Spreadsheets: Totals and Averages Fast
title: One formula averages a range
description: Shows that =AVERAGE(B7:D7) adds Gowri's three marks and divides by 3 to give 30.

topic_name: Spreadsheets: Totals and Averages Fast
title: Change a value, the formula updates
description: Before and after: changing 27 to 30 makes =AVERAGE(B7:D7) change from 30 to 31 by itself.

topic_name: Line Graphs: Temperature in Two States
title: Columns become a line
description: Shows each month's point sitting on top of its column, and the line joining the points in month order.

topic_name: Line Graphs: Temperature in Two States
title: Punjab varies more than Kerala
description: Shows the two temperature lines on one grid with only the rise of each line marked, so the main reading stands out.

topic_name: Line Graphs: Temperature in Two States
title: Why do the two states differ?
description: Shows that Punjab's temperature rises about 19 degrees in a year and Kerala's only about 4, raising the question why.

topic_name: Line Graphs: Temperature in Two States
title: Plot each point, then join
description: Shows the core move of the line graph builder: placing a point by reading across from the scale, then joining it to the line.

topic_name: Reading Line Graphs: Objects in Space
title: The three countries do not make the World count
description: Shows that in 2024 the United States, China and Russia together are about 200 short of the World count.

topic_name: Reading Line Graphs: Objects in Space
title: Steeper means a bigger change
description: Shows the United States line for 2022 to 2024: a steep rise of about 280, then a gentle rise of about 30.

topic_name: Reading Line Graphs: Objects in Space
title: 52 bars or 4 lines
description: Compares the same space launch data as a crowded clustered column graph and as four clean lines.

topic_name: Reading Line Graphs: Objects in Space
title: Go up, then across, to read a value
description: Shows how to read the value at a marked point on a line graph: up from the year to the line, then across to the scale.

topic_name: Catch the Pattern in Rain
title: How the June average is made
description: Shows four Junes of rainfall and their average, 850 millimetres.

topic_name: Catch the Pattern in Rain
title: West coast and east coast cities
description: Places the six rainfall cities on a plain outline of India in two coastal groups.

topic_name: Catch the Pattern in Rain
title: Two monsoons, two rainy seasons
description: Shows that the south west monsoon brings rain in June to September and the north east monsoon in October to December.

topic_name: Catch the Pattern in Rain
title: Peak months differ by coast
description: Shows that Udupi on the west coast peaks in June to August while Rameswaram on the east coast peaks in October to December, and both are dry in January to March.

topic_name: Infographics: Rice or Wheat?
title: Reading the rice and wheat scale
description: Shows the colour scale from −100 to +100 and what a value on it means.

topic_name: Infographics: Rice or Wheat?
title: Guess a hidden value from its neighbours
description: Shows Karnataka's hidden value surrounded by its five neighbours' values, so the child can see it should lean to rice.

topic_name: Infographics: Rice or Wheat?
title: Two ends of the scale: what explains the gap?
description: Shows Rajasthan at −93 and Manipur at +100 on the rice and wheat scale, 193 steps apart.

topic_name: Infographics: Rice or Wheat?
title: Slide to find the balanced states
description: Shows the core move of the rice and wheat map: two threshold handles on the scale mark the balanced band near zero.

topic_name: What Can a Strip Say? Sleepy-Deepy
title: Two boxes make one hour
description: Shows how a block of boxes on the 48 box strip gives the start time and the length of an activity.

topic_name: What Can a Strip Say? Sleepy-Deepy
title: Weekday sleep and holiday sleep on a strip
description: Before and after: a weekday strip with 16 boxes of sleep and a holiday strip with 20, so 4 more boxes.

topic_name: What Can a Strip Say? Sleepy-Deepy
title: Sleep across a lifetime
description: Shows the smooth curve of daily sleep against age: high at 6, lowest between 30 and 50, a little higher later.

topic_name: What Can a Strip Say? Sleepy-Deepy
title: Paint a day, count the hours
description: Shows a painted 48 box strip whose key turns each colour's box count into hours.

topic_name: Your Own Data Story

topic_name: Your Own Data Story
title: Plan of a group investigation
description: Shows the four steps of the group sleep project: question, collect, summarise, show.

topic_name: Your Own Data Story
title: Your investigation in four steps
description: Shows the plan of a data investigation: ask a question, collect data, summarise with mean and median, show it.

topic_name: Summary: Tales by Dots and Lines

topic_name: Summary: Tales by Dots and Lines
title: A winning chain in Hex
description: Shows the goal of Hex on a small board: an unbroken chain of one colour joining that player's two sides.
